title: Rodeo Valley Stable
specs: Located in Marin Headlands with access to miles of trails including beach access
Historic military buildings including 1921 Mirage Balloon Hangar and WWII vehicle sheds
Proof of up-to-date vaccinations required for Horse Hotel
Proof of liability insurance listing PRC as additionally insured for overnight stay
Horses must have basic ground manners and be safe for members to handle
Horses must be comfortable in a same-sex herd; no stallions, pregnant mares, or horses under 5 years
Boarding limited to 13 horses; new boarders admitted as spaces open

services.name: Horse Hotel
services.desc: Please Note: No turn outs available for Horse Hotel guests. Confirmation of up-to-date vaccinations must be provided upon arrival. Must provide proof of liability insurance, and list Presidio Riding Club as "additionally insured for overnight stay at land owned by National Park Service" PRC Horse Hotel provides high quality grass hay and alfalfa. If your horse has other needs, please provide the food for feeding

includes: Daily stall cleaning and feeding (Horse Hotel)
Private stall with rubber mats and bedding
High quality grass hay and alfalfa provided (Horse Hotel)
AM and PM feeding, blanketing (Boarding Membership)
gap: Age minimum for riders not stated
blurb: Guests can board their horses in private stalls with daily feeding and cleaning or stay at the Horse Hotel with access to thousands of acres of trails in the Golden Gate National Recreation Area. The club does not offer public trail rides or lessons but invites guests to bring their own horses to enjoy the trails.
extraNote: No turn outs available for Horse Hotel guests · Membership limited to 13 horses due to NPS regulations; waitlist applies · Members commit to 8 monthly workdays and 4 hours volunteering per month · Presidio Riding Club stables at 901 Bunker Road, Marin Headlands
